title: feat(scripts): check-tenant-chokepoint refuses an IS NULL arm on a tenant column, and shipped texts stop describing the retired arm (18.x step 7, part 7z)
body:
Part of #24583

Clause-②: no (the gate refusal narrows what a contributor may write in three driver files; every other change is text. No accept set, served body, error code or runtime behaviour moves)

This is step 7's closing part (7z). It leaves #24583 open for the parts still in flight: 7a-2, 7b-0 and 7b-1+7b-2.

## What changed

### 1. The D8 gate: `check-tenant-chokepoint` now refuses an `IS NULL` arm on a tenant column

ADR-0131 D8 says "`check-tenant-chokepoint` refuses an `IS NULL` arm on a tenant column." Before this PR the gate did not do that. Its header and its failure text also still taught the retired NULL-org platform-row arm as the rule.

- **Texts restated.** The header and the unscoped-door failure text now name the one predicate: `tenant_column = :tenant`, or `IN (:tenants)` under the group posture.
- **Refusal implemented.** It scans every class member and every module-level function in the three SqlDriver-family files.
  - A tenant column reference is one of three things:
    - a local bound to `this.resolveTenantField(...)`, `computeTenantField` or `computeAndRecordTenantField`;
    - anything named `tenantField` (a local, a parameter or a member);
    - the literal `'organization_id'`.
  - Refused spellings:
    - `whereNull` / `orWhereNull` / `andWhereNull` on such a reference;
    - a `where` / `orWhere` / `andWhere` with a `null` comparand, two-argument or three-argument;
    - the object form with a null value;
    - a raw fragment (`whereRaw`, `orWhereRaw`, `andWhereRaw`, `havingRaw`, `raw`) whose literal text says `IS NULL` and that names the column by substitution, by binding or literally.
  - `IS NOT NULL` is never refused.
  - Tenant bindings are scoped to their outermost container. So the filter compiler's own `whereNull(field)` on a plain column stays silent.
- **Exemptions: none.** `NULL_ARM_EXEMPT` is empty, and `main` needs no entry.
  - The `sys_audit_log.tenant_id` attribution partition that `LifecycleService` reads is a D7 field, not a D8 tenant column. It is also outside the scanned files. The header names it.
- **Floor.** `TENANT_PREDICATE_FLOOR = 3` (4 on `main`). A matcher that stops recognising the tenant column exits 2 instead of reporting clean.
- **Self-test.** A second battery, `D8 null-arm rule`, is pinned at 22 cases: 11 refused spellings, 6 silent counterparts, 2 floor-counter cases and 3 exemption-channel cases. The roster floor goes from 1 to 2.

### 2. Text drift

Comments in 15 runtime files, plus one runtime warning, said in the present tense that the driver or engine still reads organization-less rows. Each is now correct. Where code was written against the old arm, the text says so.

- spec `events.zod.ts`, `driver.zod.ts`
- runtime `domains/packages.ts`. `sys_metadata` has no organization column (D6/D7).
- plugin-security `organization-scope.ts`, `delegated-admin-gate.ts`
- plugin-sharing `backfill-sys-record-share-organizations.ts`
- plugin-webhooks `auto-enqueuer.ts`
- objectql `platform-object-tenancy.ts`. This is a runtime `evidence` string.
- service-automation `runtime-identity.ts`, `builtin/http-nodes.ts`. The latter is the runtime `[http]` warning.
- service-messaging `http-outbox.ts`, `memory-http-outbox.ts`, `sql-http-outbox.ts`
- service-storage `backfill-sys-file-organizations.ts`, `metadata-store.ts`

### 3. Docs

- `deployment/cli.mdx` (the `os migrate duplicates` table) and `deployment/seed-tenancy-repair.mdx`:
  - The live condition is now described as the record of which counter minted the duplicates. It is no longer "about to mint more". Since 7b-3, the counter refuses an organization-less row on a tenant table wherever the organization object is registered.
  - The colliding rows "stay findable by this report". The old text said "visible".
- `protocol/objectql/schema.mdx`: wherever the organization object is registered, a tenant table holds no organization-less row. On a single-organization deployment, rows are stamped with the Default Organization.
- `unique/legacy-organization-composite`: the `os explain` text in `rule-explanations.ts` and the rule docblock in `data-model-rules.ts` now carry the "wherever the organization object is registered" hedge.

### 4. Spec TSDoc

`SharingRuleRow` was described as a "Stored shape … 1-to-1 to sys_sharing_rule". It is now described as a stored row or a declared rule's projection, and `deploymentWide` is named as the one member with no column.

Changeset: `.changeset/24583-7z-closing-d8-texts.md`, `patch` for the ten packages whose shipped text changed. No existing changeset is touched.

## Proof

All runs below are on head `e5f47d90d` unless marked. That head is `main` 81120caa merged in with a merge commit.

- **Gate self-test.**
  - `node scripts/check-tenant-chokepoint.mjs --self-test` exited 0: "6 reporting shape(s), 6 silent counterpart(s) … D8 null-arm rule: 11 refused spelling(s), 6 silent counterpart(s)."
- **Ablation, on a scratch copy.** The copy is a git-initialised `git archive HEAD` of `scripts/` plus the three driver files.
  - `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `return builder.where(field, String(tenantId));` in `applyTenantScope` with a grouped callback that compiles `where(field, String(tenantId)).orWhereNull(field)`, the v17 arm. The anchor count went 1 to 0, the injection count was 1, and the blob changed from 206bca5f0bce to f741fbd69db5.
  - Under that mutation the gate exited 1 with: "1 IS NULL arm(s) on a tenant column … sql-driver.ts:15664 applyTenantScope() — orWhereNull(tenant column)".
  - Restored: the blob equals HEAD (206bca5f0bce) and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The scratch copy was green (exit 0) before the mutation.
- **Gate green on `main` plus this diff.**
  - `pnpm check:tenant-chokepoint` exited 0: "24 getBuilder() binding(s) across 3 file(s) … no IS NULL arm on a tenant column (ADR-0131 D8)."
  - Exemptions: none.
- **Spec build and generated artifacts** (pre-merge head `cd794f6`).
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` exited 0.
  - `check:generated` exited 0: "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date". Nothing was regenerated.
- **Spec suite** (pre-merge head): 703 files passed, 21360 tests passed.
- **Lint suite** (pre-merge head): 150 files passed, 6988 tests passed. The first attempt failed on a missing `@objectstack/formula` dist, before its dependency closure was built. It was re-run green after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/lint...' build`.
- **Full build** on the merged head: `pnpm build --concurrency=2` passed 76/76 tasks.
- **R1, a fresh boot** (`pnpm dev -- --fresh -p 38723`, merged head): `/api/v1/health` returned 200 and `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in/email` returned 200. The boot log had zero `error` lines. The server was torn down by its PID.
- **`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`** derived 134 commands, the same list on the pre-merge and merged heads.
  - Each command was run with its exit code captured before any pipe.
  - 128 exited 0 on the first pass, on the pre-merge head `8c68d506`.
  - 6 were prerequisite refusals: `check-engine-split-ratio` (exit 2, shallow clone), `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (exit 3, shallow clone), and `check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n` and `check:lean-entry-closure` (exit 3, no build).
  - After `git fetch --shallow-since=2026-07-15` and the full build, all 6 re-ran on the merged head and exited 0.
  - `--ran` with `cmd :: exit N` records: "134 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 134 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero …)".
- **`node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch claude/issue-24583-7z-closing`** exited 0: "0 of 23 path(s) hit the register … NOT governed".
  - `scripts/` is not a governed surface. The size is 741 changed lines, under 3000.
- **Not measured locally** (left to CI): per-package `typecheck` (comment and string changes only), `test:repo`, and the CI-only jobs that `--commands` names.

## Acceptance notes

Found along the way and left as they are. None is fixed here, because the claim's file surface is texts plus the gate.

- `memory-http-outbox.ts` `redeliver()` still admits an organization-less row for every tenant: its predicate was written to mirror the v17 SQL term. The SQL driver no longer does this. The comment now says that the two implementations disagree; the code is unchanged. Reported to the seat.
- `organizationOutOfWriteReach` (`service-storage/src/metadata-store.ts`) still answers "in reach" for an organization-less row, which D8 put out of reach. Under ADR-0131 a walled deployment holds no such row once certified. The comment says the branch predates D8.
- `applySysRecordShareOrganizationBackfill` threads `tenantId`, so under D8 its update no longer reaches an organization-less row. No runtime path calls it; the 18.x ceremony's attribution fate stamps these rows now. The comment says so.
- Test-file comments still mention the driver's "NULL-tolerant arm": `record-share-tenant-wall.test.ts` and `backfill-sys-record-share-organizations.test.ts`. They are not runtime files, so they were left.
- `core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts` ~795 ("a null-org row is global") is an authorization reader. That is 7a-2's surface, so it is left to 7a-2.
- `metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` still says `saveMetaItem` writes `organization_id = NULL` (~24069, ~29060), but `sys_metadata` has no organization column. This is a different drift class from the driver-reads-NULL one, and it is left.
